report:
# Born normalization and positive weight rays

The general Lean statements concern rational weight lists with nonzero/positive sums. Native probability APIs additionally require nonnegative coordinates. Normalization is idempotent, invariant under positive scaling, and classifies positive weight rays. Five explicit comparisons and the (1,1)/(1,-1) amplitude control are checked exactly. The latter have equal Born weights but a nonzero amplitude minor: no amplitude-ray or Born-uniqueness result follows. Full refined-carrier operad/quotient instantiation remains open.
